columns.comment: Calendar month of the ER run (quarter-end) as its first day (DATE): September 2026 = DATE'2026-09-01' (the month-end snapshot as of 30-Sep-2026). This view is monthly; point-in-time measures grouped by a longer period (quarter, half, fiscal year) return its last month. The latest month is Sep 2026.
columns.name: Month

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year label of the ER run (quarter-end), April to March: FY2026 = Apr 2026 - Mar 2027, FY2025 = Apr 2025 - Mar 2026. "This year" / YTD = FY2026 to 30-Sep-2026; year-on-year compares the same months of FY2025.
columns.name: Fiscal Year

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal quarter label, e.g. FY2026-Q2: Q1 = Apr-Jun, Q2 = Jul-Sep, Q3 = Oct-Dec, Q4 = Jan-Mar (FY2026-Q4 = Jan-Mar 2027). The latest quarter is FY2026-Q2 (Jul-Sep 2026).
columns.name: Fiscal Quarter

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal half label, e.g. FY2026-H1: H1 = Apr-Sep, H2 = Oct-Mar. H1 FY2026 (Apr-Sep 2026) closed on 30-Sep-2026; compare with FY2025-H1 for year-on-year.
columns.name: Fiscal Half

columns.comment: Always true here: this view is monthly, every row is a month-end snapshot or a whole-month total (kept so the same filter works in daily and monthly views).
columns.name: Is Month End

columns.comment: True for September 2026, the latest (as-of) month - use it for "today", "current", "latest" or "right now" questions on balances and other point-in-time measures.
columns.name: Is Latest Month

columns.comment: Client group = the global parent group, as its short brand (e.g. Kinokawa Precision, Hayashi Marine Logistics, Sunda Energi Nusantara). "Client" or "group" without qualification means this level. Match names with LIKE '%Kinokawa%'. About 380 groups.
columns.name: Client Group

columns.comment: Current golden client (legal entity) of the source record / steward candidate, e.g. Meridian Agri Holdings (Singapore) Pte Ltd - records of earlier runs are attached to today's golden client.
columns.name: Client

columns.comment: Client segment: Japanese Corporate, Non-Japanese Large Corporate, Financial Institution, Sponsor & Structured Finance or Public Sector.
columns.name: Segment

columns.comment: Relationship tier - Strategic, Core or Transactional. "Strategic clients" means Relationship Tier = Strategic.
columns.name: Relationship Tier

columns.comment: True for APAC subsidiaries of Japanese groups (segment Japanese Corporate) - "Japanese corporates", "JC" or "Japanese clients" means true.
columns.name: Is Japanese Corporate

columns.comment: Industry sector of the APAC taxonomy (e.g. Technology, Materials, Energy, Industrials); see Subsector.
columns.name: Industry

columns.comment: Industry subsector within the sector (e.g. Semiconductors, Automotive Parts, Coal Mining, Shipping).
columns.name: Subsector

columns.comment: APAC booking location covering the client, ISO-2 code: SG Singapore, HK Hong Kong, CN China, TH Thailand, ID Indonesia, IN India, AU Australia, VN Vietnam, MY Malaysia, KR South Korea, TW Taiwan, PH Philippines, NZ New Zealand. "Country" means this unless the user says risk / HQ country.
columns.name: Coverage Office

columns.comment: Primary relationship manager (fictional name) at the row's month-end: the CRM primary-RM assignment, else the group account-plan owner; null = no RM coverage.
columns.name: Primary RM

columns.comment: Office (APAC booking location, ISO-2) where the primary RM sits - "RMs in Singapore / Hong Kong" means this (most RMs also cover clients booked in other countries, so it differs from Coverage Office).
columns.name: Primary RM Office

columns.comment: Internal rating grade 1-10 in force at the row's month-end (1 best, 10 default; 7 and worse is sub-investment watch territory); null = not rated (no credit relationship).
columns.name: Rating Grade

columns.comment: IFRS 9 stage at the row's month-end: 1 performing, 2 significant increase in credit risk, 3 credit-impaired / default; null = not rated.
columns.name: IFRS 9 Stage

columns.comment: True when the client is on the credit watchlist at the row's month-end ("not on the watchlist" = false).
columns.name: Watchlist

columns.comment: KYC / AML risk rating Low, Medium or High at the row's month-end (latest completed review); null = no KYC record.
columns.name: KYC Risk Rating

columns.comment: Final early-warning band at the row's month-end: Green (score < 40), Amber (40-69) or Red (>= 70), after overrides; null = not scored (no credit relationship, or before Apr-2025).
columns.name: EWS Band

columns.comment: Entity-resolution run ER-yyyymmdd: ER-20250630, ER-20250930, ER-20251231 (rule set v1), ER-20260331 (first v2 run - the March 2026 resolution), ER-20260630, ER-20260930 (latest).
columns.name: Run

columns.comment: Rule set of the run: v1 (2025 runs) or v2 (from Mar-2026: abbreviation expansion, name + country match, cross-country blocking).
columns.name: Rule Version

columns.comment: Identity source system: core_customer (core banking), crm_account (CRM), kyc_customer (KYC), credit_obligor (credit), trade_party (trade finance), tsy_counterparty (treasury), ext_company_master (external company master). The extra value ALL is a technical row that only carries the whole-run precision / recall and holds no records (Records In = 0): exclude it when listing sources, and leave Source System out of whole-run questions (records in, match rate, golden records, precision and recall of the run).
columns.name: Source System

columns.comment: How the record was resolved in the run: deterministic, fuzzy, steward or unmatched.
columns.name: Match Method

columns.comment: Decision on a steward review item: Match or No Match; null while open.
columns.name: Steward Decision

columns.comment: Days a steward item has been / was open: 0-7 days, 8-30 days, 31-90 days, 91-180 days or Over 180 days.
columns.name: Aging Bucket

columns.comment: Source identity records in the run (latest run of the selection; per source system when grouped).
columns.name: Records In

columns.comment: Records linked to at least one other record (deterministic + fuzzy + steward) in the latest run of the selection.
columns.name: Matched Records

columns.comment: Matched records / records in (fraction; 0.987 = 98.7% at the latest run).
columns.name: Match Rate %

columns.comment: Records matched by a deterministic rule (LEI-like id, tax id + country, v2 name + country).
columns.name: Deterministic Matches

columns.comment: Records matched automatically by the fuzzy score (>= 0.90).
columns.name: Fuzzy Matches

columns.comment: Fuzzy matches / matched records (fraction).
columns.name: Fuzzy Share %

columns.comment: Records matched through a data-steward decision (score 0.75-0.90).
columns.name: Steward-Resolved Matches

columns.comment: Records left as singleton golden records in the run.
columns.name: Unmatched Records

columns.comment: Records merged into a golden record that already holds a record of the same source system (duplicates).
columns.name: Duplicates Merged

columns.comment: Golden records (resolved legal entities) of the run holding the selected records - 9,270 records collapse into 2,550 golden records at the latest run; by source system = golden records holding that source.
columns.name: Golden Records

columns.comment: Average source records collapsed into one golden record.
columns.name: Records per Golden Record

columns.comment: Share of record pairs put in one golden record that truly belong together (vs the synthetic truth; gate >= 97%). Within one source system it is that source's precision, otherwise the whole run's (ALL row) - never summed across sources. Latest run of the selection.
columns.name: Precision %

columns.comment: Share of true same-entity record pairs that the run put together (gate >= 95%; v1 runs ~93%, v2 ~98%). Within one source system it is that source's recall, otherwise the whole run's. Latest run of the selection.
columns.name: Recall %

columns.comment: Steward review items decided (Match or No Match) among the items raised by the selected runs.
columns.name: Steward Decisions

columns.comment: Steward review items still open at 30-Sep-2026 (by the run that raised them; 13 in total).
columns.name: Steward Queue Open

columns.comment: Average days the open steward items have been waiting at 30-Sep-2026.
columns.name: Average Days Open

comment: Entity-resolution quality of the six quarterly ER runs (Jun-2025 .. Sep-2026; rule set v1 to Dec-2025, v2 from Mar-2026) by source system: source identity records in, matched (deterministic / fuzzy / steward), match rate, fuzzy share, unmatched, within-source duplicates merged, golden records, records per golden record, pairwise precision and recall against the synthetic truth, and the data-steward queue (decisions, items open at 30-Sep-2026, aging). Record and golden counts are per-run snapshots: a quarter or year returns its latest run (filter Month = DATE'2026-09-01' or Is Latest Month for the latest run ER-20260930). Grain: one row per ER run x source record, per ER run x source system (incl. ALL) and per steward item (gold.mvb_entity_resolution, record_type union).
